## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security improvement

## Design

Describe affected modules, dependency changes, and important trade-offs.

## Testing

- [ ] Added or updated tests
- [ ] `python -m pytest -v` passes
- [ ] Manually verified where appropriate

## Documentation

- [ ] README or relevant guides updated
- [ ] Mermaid diagrams updated if architecture changed
- [ ] ADR added or updated if a significant decision changed
- [ ] AI-agent instructions updated if repository conventions changed

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets or API keys committed
- [ ] No sensitive diffs or customer data added to logs or fixtures
